meaning: 太妃糖
sentences: The child unwrapped a piece of taffy. 那個孩子拆開了一塊太妃糖。
Warm taffy sticks to your fingers. 溫熱的太妃糖會黏在手指上。

meaning: 像太妃糖的
sentences: The melted resin became thick and taffylike. 融化的樹脂變得濃稠得像太妃糖。
Its taffylike texture made it hard to cut. 它像太妃糖般的質地讓人很難切開。

meaning: 製作太妃糖的人
sentences: The taffymaker pulled the candy by hand. 製作太妃糖的人用手拉糖。
A skilled taffymaker can judge the temperature by feel. 熟練的太妃糖師傅能靠觸感判斷溫度。

meaning: 太妃糖製作
sentences: Taffymaking filled the shop with a sweet smell. 製作太妃糖讓整間店充滿甜香。
They learned taffymaking at a seaside festival. 他們在海邊節慶上學了太妃糖製作。

meaning: 像太妃糖般地
sentences: The syrup stretched taffywise between his hands. 糖漿在他雙手間像太妃糖般延展。
The glue pulled apart taffywise in the heat. 那膠在高溫下像太妃糖般被拉開。

meaning: 塔非亞酒；甘蔗烈酒
sentences: The barrel was filled with cheap tafia. 那個木桶裝滿了便宜的塔非亞酒。
Sailors traded tafia for supplies. 水手們用塔非亞酒換取補給。

meaning: 提非納文
sentences: The guide showed us the tafinagh letters. 導遊向我們展示了提非納文字母。
She copied her name into tafinagh for practice. 她把自己的名字抄成 tafinagh 來練習。

meaning: 將管子末端向外展開，形成寬而薄的法蘭。
sentences: To taft means to spread the end of a pipe outward so as to form a wide thin flange. 塔夫脫意味著將管子的末端向外展開，以形成寬而薄的法蘭。
People may taft in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下採取行動。

meaning: 塔夫威茲；授權離婚
sentences: The contract mentioned tafwiz in a legal note. 合約在法律附註中提到了塔夫威茲。
They discussed tafwiz in the context of marriage law. 他們在婚姻法脈絡下討論塔夫威茲。

meaning: 標籤
sentences: Please check the price tag before you buy the expensive item. 買昂貴商品前請先檢查價格標籤。
He was tagged as a primary suspect in the international case. 他被標記（貼上標籤）為該國際案件的主要嫌疑人。

meaning: 塔加比利斯族；族名
sentences: Tagabilis is named in the survey as a local group. Tagabilis 在調查中被列為一個地方族群。
Little modern data exists on Tagabilis. 關於 Tagabilis 的現代資料很少。

meaning: 塔加卡奧洛人；族名
sentences: A speaker of Tagakaolo welcomed the visitors. 一位塔加卡奧洛人向訪客表示歡迎。
The report records several Tagakaolo traditions. 報告記錄了幾項塔加卡奧洛傳統。

meaning: 他加祿人；舊稱
sentences: The old book uses Tagal for a Filipino group. 那本舊書用 Tagal 指一個菲律賓族群。
A Tagal trader appears in the travel diary. 一本遊記中出現了一位他加祿商人。

meaning: 他加拉語；舊稱
sentences: Tagala appears as an older language name in the dictionary. 字典中把 Tagala 列為較舊的語言名稱。
The missionary wrote several prayers in Tagala. 那位傳教士用 Tagala 寫了幾篇祈禱文。

meaning: 使他加祿化
sentences: The empire tried to Tagalize nearby communities. 那個政權試圖使附近社群他加祿化。
Some schools were created to Tagalize official speech. 有些學校被設立來使官方語言他加祿化。

meaning: Tagal 的變體拼法
sentences: Tagalo is a rare variant spelling in old texts. Tagalo 是舊文獻中少見的變體拼法。
The editor kept Tagalo in the quoted passage. 編者在引文中保留了 Tagalo 的寫法。

meaning: 他加祿語；他加祿人
sentences: She speaks Tagalog at home with her grandparents. 她在家裡和祖父母說他加祿語。
The movie includes a few lines in Tagalog. 那部電影裡有幾句他加祿語台詞。

meaning: 木苜蓿；樹苜蓿
sentences: The farmer planted tagasaste for fodder. 那位農夫種了木苜蓿當飼料。
Tagasaste grows well in dry soil. 木苜蓿在乾燥土壤中長得很好。

meaning: 西猯屬
sentences: Tagassu is the genus name on the specimen label. Tagassu 是標本標籤上的屬名。
The curator compared Tagassu with related genera. 館長把 Tagassu 與相關屬做比較。

meaning: 西猯科
sentences: Tagassuidae appears in the family section of the atlas. Tagassuidae 出現在圖鑑的科名部分。
Students learned that Tagassuidae includes peccaries. 學生學到 Tagassuidae 包含西猯類。

meaning: 塔格糖
sentences: This drink is sweetened with tagatose instead of sugar. 這杯飲料是用塔格糖而不是砂糖調甜的。
Tagatose has become popular in low-calorie foods. 塔格糖在低熱量食品中越來越受歡迎。

meaning: 塔高爾族；族名
sentences: Tagaur is identified as an ethnic name in the note. 附註把 Tagaur 標示為一個族名。
The archive preserves only a brief mention of Tagaur. 檔案中只保留了對 Tagaur 的簡短提及。

meaning: 塔格巴努亞人；族名
sentences: A Tagbanua elder told the story by the fire. 一位塔格巴努亞長者在火邊講了那個故事。
The museum features Tagbanua baskets and carvings. 博物館展示塔格巴努亞人的籃器與雕刻。

meaning: 厚卡紙
sentences: We used tagboard to make the poster base. 我們用厚卡紙做海報底板。
The model was cut from white tagboard. 那個模型是用白色厚卡紙裁成的。

meaning: 萬壽菊屬
sentences: Tagetes blooms brightly through the summer. 萬壽菊屬植物整個夏天都開得很鮮豔。
The gardener planted Tagetes along the path. 園丁沿著小路種了萬壽菊屬植物。

meaning: 萬壽菊醇
sentences: The oil contains a small amount of tagetol. 這種精油含有少量萬壽菊醇。
Chemists isolated tagetol from the flower extract. 化學家從花朵萃取物中分離出萬壽菊醇。

meaning: 標籤色調
sentences: The old chart used a dull tagetone for warning labels. 那張舊圖表用一種暗淡的標籤色調來做警示標記。
She matched the booklet cover to the tagetone on the box. 她把小冊子的封面配成和盒子上的標籤色調一致。

meaning: 有標籤；標記。
sentences: All the tagged items are on sale. 所有標記的商品均在促銷。
The report describes the result as tagged. 該報告將結果描述為已標記。

meaning: 貼標籤的人；標記器
sentences: The factory hired a tagger to label each bundle by hand. 工廠雇了一名貼標籤的人手工標記每一捆貨。
This tagger prints clean codes on small packages. 這台標記器能在小包裝上印出清晰的代碼。

meaning: 使纏結；使混亂
sentences: Do not taggle the ropes before the boat leaves. 船開走前不要把繩子弄得纏成一團。
A rushed move can taggle the fishing lines in seconds. 匆忙的動作幾秒內就會把釣線弄亂。

meaning: 破舊零亂的；滿是碎布條的
sentences: His old coat looked taggy after the long trip. 他那件舊外套經過長途旅行後看起來破舊零亂。
The scarecrow wore a taggy hat in the field. 稻草人戴著一頂破破爛爛的帽子站在田裡。

meaning: 塔格利克人；塔格利克語
sentences: The archive lists Taghlik among the small northern groups. 檔案把 Taghlik 列為北方的小族群之一。
A few elders still remember words from Taghlik. 仍有幾位長者記得一些 Taghlik 的詞語。

meaning: 塔吉萊石，一種礦物
sentences: The collector placed a piece of tagilite under the lamp. 收藏家把一塊塔吉萊石放到燈下。
Tagilite showed a pale shine on the broken surface. 塔吉萊石在斷面上呈現淡淡的光澤。

meaning: 塔吉什人；塔吉什語
sentences: The guide spoke about Tagish history during the tour. 導覽員在參觀途中談到 Tagish 的歷史。
Researchers recorded several songs in Tagish. 研究人員錄下了幾首 Tagish 歌曲。

meaning: 小標籤
sentences: Each seed packet had a taglet tied to the top. 每包種子頂端都繫著一張小標籤。
He wrote the sample number on a paper taglet. 他把樣本編號寫在一張紙製小標籤上。

meaning: 塔利亞科齊式的；鼻整形術相關的
sentences: The paper describes a Tagliacotian method of repair. 那篇論文描述了一種塔利亞科齊式的修補方法。
The surgeon studied Tagliacotian techniques in old texts. 那位外科醫師在古老文獻中研究塔利亞科齊式技術。

meaning: 塔利亞科齊傳統的；整形外科相關的
sentences: The museum displayed Tagliacozzian surgical drawings. 博物館展示了 Tagliacozzian 的外科圖稿。
His lecture compared modern and Tagliacozzian practice. 他的演講比較了現代做法與 Tagliacozzian 傳統。

meaning: 像標籤的
sentences: A taglike strip hung from the bag handle. 一條像標籤的細帶垂在袋把上。
The leaf has a narrow, taglike shape. 那片葉子有狹長而像標籤的形狀。

meaning: 糾結的一團；纏結
sentences: She cut through the taglock in the wool with scissors. 她用剪刀剪開羊毛裡糾結的一團。
A taglock of wire blocked the small drain. 一團纏結的鐵絲堵住了小排水口。

meaning: 破衣爛衫；衣衫襤褸的人
sentences: He arrived in tagrag after weeks on the road. 他在路上奔波數週後穿著破衣爛衫到達。
The costume shop sold a comic tagrag for the play. 戲服店為那齣戲賣一套滑稽的破爛裝。

meaning: 襤褸；破爛狀態
sentences: The director wanted a touch of tagraggery in the costume design. 導演希望戲服設計帶一點襤褸感。
Years of neglect gave the room an air of tagraggery. 多年的疏於照管讓那房間帶著破敗襤褸的氣息。

meaning: 被磨痛的；擦傷的
sentences: My neck felt tagsore after the stiff collar rubbed all day. 僵硬的領口磨了一整天後，我的脖子覺得被磨痛了。
The dog became tagsore where the rough tag touched its skin. 粗糙的牌子碰到皮膚的地方讓那隻狗磨得發痛。

meaning: 尾端標記；尾部附片
sentences: The kite had a bright tagtail for balance. 那只風箏有一條鮮亮的尾端附片來保持平衡。
He spotted the tagtail on the end of the cable. 他看到纜線末端的尾部標記。

meaning: 象牙椰子堅果；象牙椰
sentences: The artisan carved a button from tagua. 那位工匠用象牙椰子堅果雕了一顆鈕扣。
Tagua is often used as a plant-based ivory. Tagua 常被當作植物性象牙使用。

meaning: 鼯鼠
sentences: A taguan glided between the tall trees at dusk. 黃昏時，一隻鼯鼠在高樹間滑翔。
The children watched the taguan from a quiet platform. 孩子們在安靜的平台上看著那隻鼯鼠。

meaning: 塔古拉島
sentences: The boat route passes near Tagula in calm weather. 天氣平穩時，船線會經過 Tagula 附近。
A storm delayed supplies bound for Tagula. 一場風暴延誤了運往 Tagula 的補給。

meaning: 一日工；一天的工作量
sentences: He counted one full tagwerk before taking a rest. 他做滿一整天的工後才休息。
The old record lists the rent in grain and tagwerk. 舊紀錄以穀物和一日工來列出租賦。

meaning: 側面；一邊
sentences: Paint only one taha of the wooden sign. 只要把木牌的一邊上漆。
The crack runs along the taha of the bowl. 那道裂縫沿著碗的側面延伸。

meaning: 塔哈米人；塔哈米語
sentences: The notes mention Tahami as a regional language. 筆記把 Tahami 記為一種地方語言。
A scholar compared Tahami vocabulary with nearby dialects. 一位學者把 Tahami 詞彙和附近方言作了比較。

meaning: 芝麻醬
sentences: She stirred taheen into the soup for a nutty flavor. 她把芝麻醬拌進湯裡，增加堅果香味。
The market sells fresh taheen in small jars. 市場用小罐販售新鮮的芝麻醬。

meaning: 塔希爾，一種傳統重量單位
sentences: The merchant weighed the silver by the tahil. 商人以 tahil 這種傳統重量單位來秤銀子。
One tahil was enough for the small trade. 一個 tahil 的重量就足夠完成這筆小交易。

meaning: 芝麻醬
sentences: He spread tahin on warm bread at breakfast. 他早餐把芝麻醬抹在熱麵包上。
A spoon of tahin made the sauce smoother. 一匙芝麻醬讓醬汁變得更順口。

meaning: 大溪地
sentences: They planned a winter trip to Tahiti. 他們計畫冬天去 Tahiti 旅行。
The postcard from Tahiti showed a bright lagoon. 那張從 Tahiti 寄來的明信片上有明亮的潟湖。

meaning: 大溪地人；大溪地語
sentences: She learned a Tahitian song for the festival. 她為節慶學了一首 Tahitian 歌曲。
The museum has a Tahitian drum on display. 博物館正在展示一面 Tahitian 鼓。

meaning: 地窖；地下室
sentences: The jars were stored in a cool tahkhana. 那些罐子被存放在涼爽的地窖裡。
They hid the old books beneath the house in a tahkhana. 他們把舊書藏在屋下的地下室裡。

meaning: 塔爾坦人；塔爾坦語
sentences: The exhibit included a map of Tahltan territory. 展覽中包含一張 Tahltan 傳統領地的地圖。
A teacher introduced basic Tahltan greetings to the class. 老師向全班介紹了基本的 Tahltan 問候語。

meaning: 塔爾羊；野山羊
sentences: A tahr stood on the steep cliff without fear. 一隻塔爾羊毫不畏懼地站在陡峭的山崖上。
The ranger showed us tracks left by a tahr. 管理員指給我們看一隻塔爾羊留下的足跡。

meaning: 稅務區官員；收稅官
sentences: The farmers brought their papers to the tahseeldar. 農民把文件帶去交給稅務區官員。
A strict tahseeldar checked every land record. 一位嚴格的收稅官檢查了每一份土地紀錄。

meaning: 稅務區；行政分區
sentences: The village belongs to a large tahsil in the north. 那個村莊屬於北方一個大的稅務分區。
The report lists population figures for each tahsil. 報告列出了每個行政分區的人口數字。

meaning: 稅務區官員；收稅官
sentences: The tahsildar arrived early to inspect the files. 那位稅務區官員很早就到場檢查檔案。
People waited outside the office to meet the tahsildar. 人們在辦公室外等著見那位收稅官。

meaning: 塔辛，名字
sentences: Tahsin signed the letter at the bottom of the page. Tahsin 在頁面底部簽了名。
We met Tahsin during the language workshop. 我們在語言工作坊認識了 Tahsin。

meaning: 祭司；專家工匠
sentences: The village asked a tahua to bless the canoe. 村民請一位祭司為獨木舟祝福。
Only a skilled tahua could finish that carving. 只有熟練的專家工匠才能完成那件雕刻。

meaning: 台語族；台人
sentences: The book traces the migration of Tai peoples. 這本書追溯了 Tai 諸民族的遷徙。
Several Tai languages are spoken across the region. 這個地區有數種 Tai 語言被使用。

meaning: 台，一種傳統單位
sentences: The jeweler measured the gold in tai. 珠寶商以 tai 這種傳統單位來計量黃金。
Half a tai was enough for the pendant. 做那個墜子用半個 tai 就夠了。

meaning: 毛利長矛杖
sentences: The performer held a taiaha during the dance. 表演者在舞蹈時握著一把毛利長矛杖。
A carved taiaha hung on the meeting hall wall. 一把雕刻精美的毛利長矛杖掛在會堂的牆上。

meaning: 小釘；短尖樁
sentences: He fixed the mat with a small taich at each corner. 他在每個角落用一枚小釘固定墊子。
The carpenter dropped a taich on the floor. 那位木匠把一枚短尖樁掉在地上。

meaning: 泰加林；針葉林帶
sentences: The train crossed miles of taiga before dawn. 火車在天亮前穿越了數英里的泰加林。
Few roads cut through the dense taiga. 幾乎沒有道路穿過那片茂密的針葉林帶。

meaning: 糾纏；拖拉不清
sentences: Do not taigle over a decision that is already clear. 對已經很清楚的決定不要再拖拉糾纏。
They taigled with the same small issue all morning. 他們整個早上都在同一個小問題上糾纏不清。

meaning: 愛糾纏的；拖拖拉拉的
sentences: His taiglesome style slowed the whole meeting. 他拖拖拉拉的作風讓整場會議慢了下來。
The debate became taiglesome and unproductive. 那場辯論變得愛糾纏又沒有成效。

meaning: 慢著；別急
sentences: Taihoa, we should read the map again. 慢著，我們應該再看一次地圖。
The guide called out, "Taihoa," before anyone moved. 嚮導在大家動身前喊了一聲「慢著」。

meaning: 客棧；茶館
sentences: Travelers rested in a taikhana beside the road. 旅人們在路旁的一間客棧休息。
They met at a quiet taikhana near the market. 他們在市場附近一間安靜的茶館碰面。

meaning: 尾巴
sentences: The happy dog wagged its tail when its owner came home. 當主人回家時，開心的狗搖起了尾巴。
The cat's long tail was twitching with excitement. 貓的長尾巴因興奮而抽動著。

meaning: 尾數費；按尾數計的費用
sentences: The farmer paid tailage for each animal in the herd. 農夫為牛群中的每一頭牲口繳了按尾數計的費用。
Old accounts recorded tailage beside the grazing tax. 舊帳冊把尾數費記在放牧稅旁邊。

meaning: 書脊飾帶；尾帶
sentences: The binder replaced the worn tailband on the book. 裝訂師更換了那本書磨損的書脊尾帶。
A red tailband gave the volume a neat finish. 一條紅色書脊飾帶讓那本書收邊更整齊。

meaning: 後擋板
sentences: He lowered the tailboard to unload the crates. 他放下後擋板來卸貨箱。
Mud splashed across the truck's tailboard. 泥水濺滿了卡車的後擋板。

meaning: 有尾的
sentences: The drawing showed a tailed creature with wings. 那張圖畫顯示一隻有尾的有翼生物。
A tailed comet appeared low in the evening sky. 一顆帶著長尾的彗星出現在傍晚天空低處。

meaning: 末位者；殿後者
sentences: The tailender crossed the finish line well after the leaders. 那名末位者在領先者之後很久才通過終點。
Even the tailender received applause from the crowd. 連最後一名都獲得了群眾的掌聲。

meaning: 尾隨者；尾部部件
sentences: A suspicious tailer followed the reporter through the station. 一名可疑的尾隨者穿過車站跟著那位記者。
The machine needs a new tailer at the back. 那台機器後方需要一個新的尾部部件。

meaning: 小尾巴
sentences: The costume had a short tailet sewn to the back. 那套服裝後面縫著一條短小尾巴。
A tiny tailet trailed from the kite. 風箏後面拖著一條小尾巴。

meaning: 尾部在前地
sentences: The fish slipped tailfirst into the narrow trap. 那條魚尾部在前地滑進狹窄的陷阱。
He backed the sled tailfirst through the gate. 他讓雪橇以尾部在前的方式倒退穿過大門。

meaning: 尾狀花；穗尾花
sentences: A pale tailflower drooped over the stone wall. 一朵淡色的尾狀花垂在石牆上方。

An old cartoon used Teaguelander as a stereotype. 一幅老漫畫把 Teaguelander 當成刻板形象。

meaning: 茶館
sentences: We rested in a quiet teahouse by the lake. 我們在湖邊一間安靜的茶館休息。
The teahouse serves only three kinds of tea. 那間茶館只供應三種茶。

meaning: 略帶茶味的
sentences: The drink was fruity but slightly teaish. 那杯飲料有果香，但略帶茶味。
Its brown shade looked teaish under the light. 在燈光下，它的褐色看起來有點像茶。

meaning: 茶道觀
sentences: The essay treats teaism as a way of living. 那篇文章把飲茶哲學視為一種生活方式。
He discovered teaism through art and ritual. 他透過藝術與儀式接觸到 teaism。

meaning: 柚木
sentences: The table is made of solid high-quality teak wood. 這張桌子是由實心高品質柚木製成的。
Teak is a very durable and expensive type of wood. 柚木是一種非常耐用且昂貴的木材。

meaning: 燒水壺
sentences: The teakettle began to whistle on the stove. 燒水壺在爐上開始鳴叫。
Steam rose from the old enamel teakettle. 蒸氣從那只舊搪瓷燒水壺冒了出來。

meaning: 柚木
sentences: The bench was made of polished teakwood. 那張長椅是用拋光柚木做的。
Rain does little harm to good teakwood. 雨水對優質柚木傷害不大。

meaning: 深色，略帶藍綠色；深青色。
sentences: She painted the door teal. 她把門漆成藍綠色。
The scarf is a deep teal color. 那條圍巾是深藍綠色。

meaning: 像茶葉的
sentences: The sauce had a tealeafy bitterness. 那醬汁帶著茶葉般的微苦。
Her perfume turned unexpectedly tealeafy after an hour. 一小時後，她的香水意外地變得有茶葉氣息。

meaning: 茶店
sentences: A small tealery opened across the street. 街對面開了一家小茶店。
The writer spent mornings in the local tealery. 那位作家常在當地茶店度過早晨。

meaning: 無茶的
sentences: Breakfast felt empty and tealess. 沒有茶的早餐讓人覺得少了點什麼。
The office was strangely tealess all day. 辦公室整天都異常地沒有茶。

meaning: 碲鉛錫礦
sentences: The sample contained streaks of teallite. 樣本中含有 teallite 的條紋。
The geologist labeled the gray mineral teallite. 地質學家把那種灰色礦物標記為 teallite。

meaning: 團隊
sentences: Our team worked together to complete the project on time. 我們團隊齊心協力，準時完成了專案。
Which football team do you support? 你支持哪支足球隊？

meaning: 製茶者
sentences: The teamaker checked the leaves by hand. 製茶者用手檢查茶葉。
A skilled teamaker can judge heat by smell. 熟練的製茶者能憑氣味判斷火候。

meaning: 製茶
sentences: Humidity matters a lot in teamaking. 濕度在製茶過程中非常重要。
She studied teamaking in the mountain villages. 她在山村研究製茶。

meaning: 茶工
sentences: A teaman delivered fresh leaves before dawn. 一位茶工在天亮前送來新鮮茶葉。
The old teaman knew every field on the slope. 那位老茶工熟悉坡上的每一塊茶田。

meaning: 古文獻中的植物名
sentences: The herbal list includes teameo near the end. 那份草藥清單在末尾列出了 teameo。
No modern guide agrees on what teameo was. 現代指南對 teameo 是什麼都沒有一致說法。

meaning: 車隊駕馭者
sentences: The strongest teamer handled the front horses. 最強壯的車隊駕馭者負責前面的馬匹。
Each teamer was paid by the trip. 每位車隊駕馭者都按趟次領薪。

meaning: 成群的
sentences: We saw teaming fish near the rocks. 我們在岩石附近看見成群的魚。
The field was teaming with insects after rain. 雨後田裡滿是成群活動的昆蟲。

meaning: 役畜用地
sentences: The farmer saved the flat ground as teamland. 那位農夫把平地留作役畜用地。
In the record, teamland was taxed differently. 在紀錄裡，teamland 的課稅方式不同。

meaning: 無隊伍的
sentences: Without support, the rider felt teamless. 缺少支援時，那名騎手覺得自己像沒有隊伍。
A teamless wagon stood by the gate. 一輛沒有拉畜隊的車停在門邊。

meaning: 車隊駕者
sentences: The teamman tightened every strap before leaving. 車隊駕者出發前把每條皮帶都拉緊。
An experienced teamman can calm nervous horses. 有經驗的車隊駕者能安撫緊張的馬。

meaning: 屬於同一個團隊的人。
sentences: Pass the ball to your teammate. 把球傳給你的隊友。
A good teammate helps when practice gets hard. 好隊友會在練習變困難時幫忙。

meaning: 隊員
sentences: Each teamsman knew his place in the line. 每位隊員都知道自己在隊列中的位置。
The youngest teamsman walked beside the cart. 最年輕的 teamsman 走在車旁。

meaning: 運貨車司機
sentences: A teamster guided the truck through the storm. 卡車司機在暴風雨中把車開了過去。
Her grandfather worked as a teamster for thirty years. 她祖父當了三十年的運貨車司機。

meaning: 以團隊方式地
sentences: Teamwise, the project went better than expected. 從團隊層面來看，這個專案進行得比預期好。
We are strong teamwise but short on time. 就團隊合作而言我們很強，但時間不足。

meaning: 一群人為實現共同目標而共同努力。
sentences: Teamwork helped us finish the project early. 團隊合作幫助我們提早完成專案。
The coach praised their teamwork after the game. 教練在賽後稱讚他們的團隊合作。

meaning: 古文獻中的術語
sentences: The scribe copied tean exactly as he saw it. 抄寫員照著原樣把 tean 抄了下來。
Linguists treat tean as a doubtful old form. 語言學家把 tean 視為可疑的古老形式。

meaning: 一種與茶相關的有機化合物
sentences: Teanal was stored in a sealed vial at the lab. 實驗室把 teanal 裝在密封的小瓶中保存。
The researchers compared fresh teanal with the older sample. 研究人員把新鮮的 teanal 與較舊的樣本作比較。

meaning: 茶香
sentences: A soft teap filled the room when the lid was lifted. 蓋子掀開時，房間裡瀰漫著淡淡的茶香。
The old shop was known for the warm teap of its black tea. 那家老店以紅茶溫暖的茶香聞名。

meaning: 茶壺
sentences: The teapot is full of hot tea. 茶壺裡裝滿熱茶。
She washed the teapot after breakfast. 她早餐後洗了茶壺。

meaning: 一茶壺的量
sentences: She drank a teapotful of jasmine tea by herself. 她一個人喝完了一整茶壺的茉莉花茶。
We ordered a teapotful so everyone could have a cup. 我們點了一整壺，這樣每個人都能喝一杯。

meaning: 小茶壺
sentences: The dollhouse table had a tiny teapottykin on it. 玩具屋的桌上放著一只小茶壺。
Grandma smiled when she found the silver teapottykin. 奶奶找到那只銀色小茶壺時笑了。

meaning: 茶几
sentences: He set the cups on the teapoy near the window. 他把杯子放在窗邊的茶几上。
The old teapoy matched the carved wooden chairs. 那張老茶几和雕花木椅很相配。

meaning: 撕
sentences: There is a tear in my shirt. 我的襯衫上有一道裂口。
She tried not to shed a tear during the speech. 她演講時努力不掉眼淚。

meaning: 易撕裂的
sentences: This paper is so tearable that children can use it safely. 這種紙很容易撕開，所以孩子也能安全使用。
The bag looked strong, but the material was actually tearable. 那個袋子看起來很結實，但材質其實很容易撕裂。

meaning: 易撕裂性
sentences: The designer tested the tearableness of the thin fabric. 設計師測試了這種薄布料的易撕裂性。
Its tearableness made the wrapper unsuitable for shipping. 它的易撕裂性讓這種包裝紙不適合運送。

meaning: 容易撕裂地
sentences: The cloth split tearably along the weak seam. 這塊布沿著脆弱的接縫很容易地裂開了。
The cheap poster was printed on paper that folded and tore tearably. 那張便宜海報印在一折就容易撕裂的紙上。

meaning: 撕裂損耗
sentences: The factory measured tearage during the packaging test. 工廠在包裝測試中測量撕裂損耗。
Too much tearage meant the material had to be replaced. 撕裂損耗太高代表這種材料必須更換。

meaning: 愛哭的人
sentences: His cousins called him a tearcat when he was little. 他小時候表親們都叫他愛哭鬼。
She was no tearcat, even after the harsh news. 即使聽到嚴厲的消息，她也不是那種愛哭的人。

meaning: 拆解分析
sentences: The engineer published a full teardown of the new phone. 工程師公布了新手機的完整拆解分析。
We watched a teardown to learn how the machine worked. 我們看了一段拆解分析來了解那台機器如何運作。

meaning: 淚滴
sentences: A single teardrop rolled down her cheek. 一滴眼淚沿著她的臉頰滑下。
The pendant was shaped like a teardrop. 那個墜飾做成淚滴形狀。

meaning: 撕裂者
sentences: The tearer ripped open the box with one quick pull. 那個撕開包裝的人一下就把盒子拉開了。
A small metal tearer was attached to the package. 包裝上附著一個小金屬撕裂器。

meaning: 伴隨著淚水；哭了，或是快要哭了。
sentences: Aaron got a little tearful until Laura came to reassure him. 亞倫有點哭了，直到蘿拉過來安慰他。
The report describes the result as tearful. 報道稱這項結果令人淚目。

meaning: 含淚地
sentences: She tearfully thanked her teacher at graduation. 她在畢業典禮上含淚感謝老師。
He tearfully read the last page of the letter. 他含著眼淚讀完那封信的最後一頁。

meaning: 含淚狀態
sentences: Her tearfulness surprised everyone in the meeting. 她在會議中的含淚狀態讓大家都很意外。
The film left him with a quiet tearfulness. 那部電影讓他留下安靜的淚意。

meaning: 巨大的;規模大或影響大
sentences: a tearing great giant of a man 一個令人流淚的偉大男人
The report describes the result as tearing. 報告將結果描述為撕裂。

meaning: 無淚的
sentences: He gave a tearless farewell and walked away. 他無淚地道別後就走開了。
The child remained tearless after the small fall. 那個孩子輕輕跌倒後仍然沒有哭。

meaning: 無淚地
sentences: She spoke tearlessly about the hard year. 她無淚地談起那艱難的一年。
He stood tearlessly beside the grave. 他站在墓旁，沒有落淚。

meaning: 無淚狀態
sentences: His tearlessness made him seem unusually calm. 他的無淚狀態讓他看起來異常冷靜。
The nurse noted the baby's tearlessness during the exam. 護理師在檢查時注意到嬰兒沒有流淚。

meaning: 小淚滴
sentences: A tiny tearlet shone at the corner of her eye. 一小滴淚珠在她眼角閃著光。
The poem describes each tearlet as a pearl. 那首詩把每一小滴淚珠都寫成珍珠。

meaning: 像淚滴的
sentences: The glass ornament had a tearlike shape. 那個玻璃飾品有淚滴般的形狀。
Rain hung in tearlike drops on the wire. 雨水像淚滴一樣掛在鐵絲上。

meaning: 茶室
sentences: We rested in a quiet tearoom after the walk. 散步後我們在一間安靜的茶室休息。
The tearoom served cakes on blue plates. 那間茶室用藍色盤子端上蛋糕。

meaning: 積淚小凹處
sentences: The doctor examined the tearpit near her eye. 醫生檢查了她眼旁積淚的小凹處。
Dust had gathered at the edge of the tearpit. 灰塵積在那個積淚小凹處的邊緣。

meaning: 防淚水的
sentences: She chose tearproof makeup for the ceremony. 她為典禮選了防淚水的化妝品。
The note was written with tearproof ink. 那張紙條是用不怕淚水暈開的墨水寫的。

meaning: 淚痕
sentences: A faint tearstain marked the old letter. 那封舊信上留著淡淡的淚痕。
The pillow still had a dark tearstain on it. 枕頭上還留著一塊深色的淚痕。

meaning: 酸味牧草
sentences: The farmer said the cows disliked the teart in that field. 農夫說牛不喜歡那塊地裡帶酸味的牧草。
Too much teart made the feed hard to use. 過多的酸味牧草讓飼料難以使用。

meaning: 刺耳嗓音
sentences: His tearthroat could be heard across the market. 他那刺耳的嗓音在市場另一頭都聽得見。
The actor used a rough tearthroat for the villain. 那位演員用刺耳的嗓音來表現反派。

meaning: 拇指裂傷
sentences: He wrapped his tearthumb before going back to work. 他包好拇指裂傷後才回去工作。
A bad tearthumb made it painful to hold the knife. 拇指裂傷很嚴重，讓他握刀時很痛。

meaning: 一個人，眼裡充滿淚水；傾向於哭泣。
sentences: No wonder Ryan was teary; he missed his parents. 難怪瑞安淚流滿面。他想念他的父母。
The report describes the result as teary. 報告稱這項結果令人淚目。

meaning: 可取笑的
sentences: His mistake was small but highly teasable among friends. 他的失誤雖小，卻很容易成為朋友間取笑的話題。
The character is awkward in a warm and teasable way. 這個角色笨拙得可愛，很容易被拿來開玩笑。

meaning: 可逗弄性
sentences: The writer used the hero's teasableness for comic scenes. 作者利用主角的可逗弄性來安排喜劇場面。
Her teasableness made the group laugh without offense. 她那種可逗弄性讓大家發笑卻不覺得冒犯。

meaning: 可取笑地
sentences: He smiled teasably and let his friends joke about the photo. 他帶著可被取笑的神情微笑，任朋友拿那張照片開玩笑。
The story presents the boy teasably rather than cruelly. 這個故事把那男孩寫得可被調侃，而不是可憐地被羞辱。

meaning: 逗
sentences: Don't tease your younger brother; it's not a very nice thing to do. 不要逗（戲弄）妳弟弟；那不是件好事。
They used to tease him about his glasses when he was in school. 他們以前在他上學時常拿他的眼鏡開玩笑。

meaning: 可逗弄的
sentences: She has a teaseable laugh that everyone remembers. 她的笑聲很有趣，讓人忍不住想逗她一下。
The puppy was playful and easily teaseable. 那隻小狗很愛玩，也很容易被逗弄。

meaning: 可逗弄性
sentences: The kitten's teaseableness delighted the children. 小貓的可逗弄性讓孩子們很開心。
Her natural teaseableness kept the mood light. 她天生那種可逗弄性讓氣氛一直很輕鬆。

meaning: 可逗弄地
sentences: He answered teaseably, inviting one more joke from the group. 他用一種可逗弄的方式回答，引來大家再開一個玩笑。
The actor played the role teaseably but never meanly. 那位演員把角色演得很適合被調侃，但不帶惡意。

meaning: 逗弄用的小孔
sentences: The children peeped through the teasehole in the curtain. 孩子們從窗簾上的小孔偷看。
A tiny teasehole in the box let the cat paw at the string. 盒子上的一個小孔讓貓可以伸爪去撥那條線。

meaning: 起絨蓟
sentences: The dried teasel stood tall at the edge of the field. 乾燥的起絨蓟高高立在田邊。
Workers once used teasel heads to raise the nap on cloth. 工人過去曾用起絨蓟的花頭把布面刷起絨毛。

meaning: 起絨工
sentences: The teaseler brushed the wool with practiced hands. 那位起絨工熟練地刷理羊毛。
An old teaseler explained the craft to the visitors. 一位老起絨工向訪客解說這門手藝。

meaning: 販賣起絨蓟的人
sentences: The teaseller brought bundles of dried stems to market. 那個賣起絨蓟的人把一捆捆乾燥莖帶到市場。
A local teaseller supplied workshops in the region. 當地一位起絨蓟販子為這個地區的工坊供貨。

meaning: 像起絨蓟的
sentences: The seed head looked teasellike in the afternoon light. 那個種頭在午後光線下看起來像起絨蓟。
She sketched a teasellike plant in her notebook. 她在筆記本裡畫了一株像起絨蓟的植物。

meaning: 蓟狀草本植物
sentences: The guide pointed out a patch of teaselwort by the path. 嚮導指出小徑旁一片蓟狀草本植物。
Teaselwort grows well in open, dry ground. 這種蓟狀草本植物在開闊乾燥的土地上長得很好。

meaning: 戲弄
sentences: His constant teasement finally annoyed the whole table. 他不停的戲弄最後讓整桌人都不耐煩了。
What began as light teasement soon turned awkward. 原本輕鬆的戲弄很快就變得尷尬。

meaning: 一個喜歡取笑或取笑的人。
sentences: The movie teaser made everyone curious. 電影預告讓大家都很好奇。
He can be a teaser, but he never means to hurt anyone. 他有時愛逗人，但從來不是想傷害別人。

meaning: 茶館
sentences: We met at the teashop near the station. 我們在車站附近的茶館碰面。
That teashop sells fresh cakes every morning. 那家茶館每天早上都賣新鮮蛋糕。

meaning: 焦躁
sentences: A strange teasiness spread through the room before the results were announced. 成績公布前，房間裡瀰漫著一股奇怪的焦躁感。
His teasiness faded after the phone finally rang. 電話終於響起後，他的焦躁慢慢消退了。

meaning: 頑皮地令人惱火，尤其是嘲笑。
sentences: The children exchanged teasing remarks during recess. 課間休息時，孩子們互相開玩笑。
The report describes the result as teasing. 該報告將這一結果描述為戲弄性的。

meaning: 戲弄地
sentences: She teasingly hid the last cookie behind her back. 她戲弄地把最後一塊餅乾藏到背後。
He teasingly asked if we had forgotten his birthday. 他半開玩笑地問我們是不是忘了他的生日。

meaning: 梳絨器
sentences: The wool passed through a teasler before dyeing. 羊毛在染色前先經過梳絨器處理。
An old teasler sat in the corner of the workshop. 一台老舊的梳絨器放在工坊角落。

meaning: 茶匙，一茶匙的量
sentences: She added two teaspoons of sugar to her coffee. 她在咖啡裡加了兩茶匙糖。
Please use a teaspoon to stir the tea. 請利用茶匙攪拌茶水。

meaning: 一茶匙的量
sentences: Add a teaspoonful of sugar to the sauce. 在醬汁裡加一茶匙的糖。
The child took a teaspoonful of medicine. 那個孩子吃了一茶匙的藥。

meaning: 焦躁的
sentences: He became teasy while waiting for the interview call. 等面試電話時，他變得很焦躁。
The dog looked teasy during the thunderstorm. 打雷時，那隻狗看起來很不安。

meaning: 奶頭，乳頭
sentences: The puppy was searching for its mother's teat. 小狗正在尋找母狗的乳頭。
The doctor provided advice on cleaning baby bottle teats. 醫生提供了關於清潔嬰兒奶瓶奶嘴的建議。

meaning: 品茶師
sentences: The teataster judged the aroma before taking a sip. 品茶師先判斷香氣，再啜飲一口。
A skilled teataster can notice very small differences. 熟練的品茶師能察覺非常細微的差別。

meaning: 有乳頭狀突起的
sentences: The jar had a teated lid for easier pouring. 那個罐子的蓋子有乳頭狀突起，比較好倒出內容物。
They described the shell as teated and slightly rough. 他們把那個外殼形容為有乳頭狀突起且略顯粗糙。

meaning: 乳突魚
sentences: A small teatfish hid beneath the rock. 一條小乳突魚躲在岩石下。

meaning: 心葉草屬植物

sentences: The fisherman repaired his tenai before dawn. 漁夫在黎明前修理他的傳統小舟。

meaning: 夾形防禦工事
sentences: The old fort still had a stone tenaille. 那座古堡仍保有石造的夾形防禦工事。

meaning: 小型夾形堡
sentences: A tenaillon protected the outer wall. 一座小型夾形堡保護著外牆。
The guide pointed out the ruined tenaillon. 導覽員指出那座毀損的小型夾形堡。

meaning: 特納克塔克
sentences: Tenaktak sits on a remote northern shore. 特納克塔克位於偏遠的北方海岸。
Only a few maps mark Tenaktak clearly. 只有少數地圖清楚標出特納克塔克。

meaning: 租賃，租期
sentences: The tenancy agreement outlines the rules for the rented property. 租賃協議概述了租賃財產的規則。
The project was completed during his tenancy as manager. 該專案在他擔任經理的任期（租期/在職期間）內完成了。

meaning: 租戶、房客
sentences: The new tenants moved into the small wooden cottage earlier this morning. 新租戶今天清晨搬進了那座小木屋。
Our landlord is very reasonable and always responds quickly to his tenants. 我們的房東非常通情達理，總是能迅速回應他的房客（租戶）。

meaning: 適於出租的
sentences: The flat is clean and tenantable now. 那間公寓現在乾淨到可以出租入住。

meaning: 可出租性
sentences: The tenantableness of the building improved after renovation. 翻修後，那棟建築的可出租性提高了。
They assessed the tenantableness of each room. 他們評估每個房間的可出租性。

meaning: 承租人
sentences: The tenanter signed the lease this morning. 承租人今天早上簽了租約。

meaning: 像房客的

meaning: 租戶群
sentences: The estate kept a record of its tenantry. 那座莊園保存著租戶群的紀錄。

meaning: 房客身分

meaning: 丁鱥

meaning: 丁鱥草
sentences: Tenchweed spread across the pond in summer. 夏天時丁鱥草蔓延整個池塘。

meaning: 坦克特里人
sentences: The Tencteri were an ancient Germanic tribe. 坦克特里人是古代的日耳曼部族。

meaning: 趨向
sentences: She tends to get nervous before giving a speech in public. 她在大眾面前演講前傾向於（往往會）感到緊張。

meaning: 趨勢

meaning: 傾向的

The discussion became tendant toward blame. 討論逐漸傾向責怪。

meaning: 趨勢

meaning: 趨勢

meaning: 有偏向的

meaning: 帶偏向地
sentences: He quoted the witness tendentiously. 他帶偏向地引用證人的話。
The story was edited tendentiously for effect. 那個故事被刻意偏向地編修以製造效果。

meaning: 偏頗
sentences: The judge warned against tendentiousness in the report. 法官警告那份報告不應帶有偏頗。
Readers quickly noticed its tendentiousness. 讀者很快就注意到它的傾向性。

meaning: 標
sentences: The steak was cooked to perfection, incredibly tender and juicy. 這塊牛排煮得恰到好處，無比鮮嫩多汁。

sentences: We checked the tenderability of each document. 我們檢查每份文件的可正式提交性。

meaning: 受標人
sentences: The tenderee reviewed the purchase offer carefully. 受標人仔細審閱那份購買提議。

meaning: 投標人

meaning: 新手

Do not mock a tenderfoot for asking questions. 不要因為新手發問就嘲笑他。

meaning: 像新手的
sentences: His tenderfootish mistakes slowed the team. 他那些像新手般的錯誤拖慢了團隊。
She laughed at her own tenderfootish fear. 她笑自己那種像新手般的害怕。

meaning: 充滿柔情的
sentences: Her tenderful voice calmed the child. 她充滿柔情的聲音安撫了孩子。

meaning: 溫柔地

meaning: 肌腱修補術

meaning: 溫柔

meaning: 腱鞘的

meaning: 卷鬚

meaning: 生有卷鬚的

meaning: 卷鬚的

He noted the tendrillar growth near the stem. 他注意到莖旁的卷鬚狀生長。

meaning: 腱狀纖維

meaning: 暗燭禮

meaning: 陰暗的

meaning: 黑暗

meaning: 幽暗地

meaning: 廉租公寓，物業
